prompt:
Full body portrait of Hu Fucai, an Eighth Route Army soldier, captured in a realistic historical film style. He stands in a dynamic, alert posture, suggesting agility and resourcefulness. 

**Distinctive Feature:** He is prominently gripping a wooden-handled stick grenade (potato masher style) in his right hand, prepared for action. 

**Subject Details:** He wears a dust-covered, faded blue-grey cotton uniform of the Eighth Route Army with white leg wrappings (puttees) and black cloth shoes. A leather ammunition belt is strapped around his waist. His face is youthful but sharp, with quick, intelligent eyes and a slight, confident smirk that conveys his witty and cheerful personality even in danger. He looks ready to outsmart the enemy. 

**Lighting & Composition:** High-contrast, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting. A strong rim light outlines his silhouette against the background. The background is a solid, deep charcoal grey, completely void of distractions, focusing entirely on the figure. 

**Technical Specs:** 85mm portrait lens, f/1.8, sharp focus on the face and the grenade, smooth fall-off to the feet. Cinematic color grading, slightly desaturated with gritty texture.
